patch_list: NoBrokerHood: Clear top billboard at state creation (test)
Replace TopAdState's list with an empty list at construction.
NoBrokerHood: Default browser, block known ad hosts (experimental)
Use Android browser for genuine links; block known Multipl redirect hosts.
NoBrokerHood: Hide app-bar banners (experimental)
Empty app-bar banner entries; may leave a layout placeholder.
NoBrokerHood: Hide app-bar island row (test)
Skip the AppBarIsland.kt horizontal row. May hide non-ad items.
NoBrokerHood: Hide app-bar response cards (experimental)
Remove app-bar advertising card data before creating banner state.
NoBrokerHood: Hide default post-approval card (experimental)
Hide the fallback ad card after entry approval. Null handling is untested.
NoBrokerHood: Hide expanded notification images (experimental)
Hide large banner images in entry/exit notifications while retaining text (3.6.11).
NoBrokerHood: Hide feed ad cards
Hide forum/home-feed ad cards (3.6.11).
NoBrokerHood: Hide home-discover carousel (experimental)
Hide cards in the homepage discover carousel; may hide non-ad items too.
NoBrokerHood: Hide homepage top ads (experimental)
Supply an empty top-ad list and disable its loading/expanded state.
NoBrokerHood: Hide post-approval ad card (experimental)
Hide the sponsored card shown after entry approval or pre-approval (3.6.11).
NoBrokerHood: Hide promotional popups
Suppress app-level marketing dialogs (3.6.11).
NoBrokerHood: Hide promotional side tab (experimental)
Suppress the draggable multimedia promotion card; verify on-device.
NoBrokerHood: Hide real RIGHT_AD side tab (test)
Skip the SideAd.kt Compose renderer attached to the RIGHT_AD home section.
NoBrokerHood: Hide visitor-flow ads
Hide the visitor-flow promotional carousel (3.6.11).
NoBrokerHood: Stop full-screen permission nag
Stop the home-screen full-screen alert reminder without changing permissions.
